subject: Hosted API pricing request + NDA for rate card access
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@brightapps.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-27T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: hosted API rate card and baseline pricing

Hi Kimberly,

We're evaluating options to power an LLM-based search feature in BrightApps and would like your hosted API rate card (baseline pricing + discount tiers). Procurement will need a signed mutual NDA before we can accept a PDF with internal rates.

High level: 3rd-party SaaS, likely US-region traffic, initial pilot ~2M tokens/month with production expected to ramp to ~50M tokens/month over 12 months. Can you also include any committed-capacity discounts or multi-year pricing examples?

Can you send the NDA (DocuSign or PDF) and the latest rate card versioning notes? We prefer a single PDF with a visible version string so we can track internal approvals.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if helpful.

Best,
Elaine Park
Director of Platform Ops
BrightApps
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Elaine Park <elaine@brightapps.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-27T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API rate card and baseline pricing

Hi Elaine — thanks for the context.

We can absolutely share our hosted API rate card and sample committed-capacity models. Procurement's NDA request is standard — I attached a short mutual NDA via DocuSign for quick signature: https://na1.docusign.net/envelope/12345678-ABCD (envelope prepared, countersign only). If procurement prefers a PDF first, we can also provide a redacted public baseline but internal rates require the signed mutual NDA.

Timeline: if we get a signed NDA today, I can send the internal rate card (PDF, v1.0) within the same business day.

A few quick asks to tailor the pricing sample:
- Confirm estimated monthly tokens for pilot and steady-state (you listed ~2M -> 50M; if you have a month-by-month ramp that helps).
- Will BrightApps require dedicated capacity (reserved GPU) or is hosted shared capacity acceptable for production?

I'll loop in Marcus (account lead) for commercial follow-up.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-02-27T15:42:00-08:00

Thanks — received the signed NDA (attached to thread). Per our standard workflow, I'm sharing the internal rate card as an attached PDF: redwood_ratecard_hosted_v1.0.pdf (internal rates, do not distribute).

Highlights included in the PDF:
- Baseline per-1k-token rates for text generation and embeddings
- Discount tiers by committed monthly token volume (3 tiers: 25k-1M, 1M-10M, 10M+)
- Illustration of a 3-year committed discount model and how credits are applied on invoices
- Notes about Dedicated vs Hosted pricing and where additional SLA charges apply

Quick TL;DR for your procurement checklist:
- Version: v1.0 (redwood_ratecard_hosted_v1.0.pdf)
- Change log: initial internal release for BrightApps on 2027-02-27
- Committed discounts are applied as invoice credits prorated monthly unless a prepayment option is chosen

Action items: if you can confirm the expected steady-state monthly token volume and whether you require Dedicated, Marcus can produce an illustrative quote (line items + total expected monthly spend) and I can provide a tracked v1.1 with any negotiated rates.

Attachments (this message): redwood_ratecard_hosted_v1.0.pdf

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Elaine Park <elaine@brightapps.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@brightapps.com, samir.rao@brightapps.com
Date: 2027-03-01T10:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API rate card and baseline pricing

Kimberly — thanks for the fast turnaround and the NDA. We reviewed v1.0 and have a few clarifying asks before we accept an illustrative quote: 

1) In the committed discounts sheet, how are multi-year commitments treated versus monthly commitments? Do you provide a step-down for year-2/year-3?
2) For the 10M+ tier, is there a negotiated cap on per-token price after discounts if usage spikes above forecast?
3) Does the rate card include any credits for model-eval spend (we will run heavier evals early in the pilot)?

Estimated steady-state for our quote exercise: 30M tokens/month (US region), requirement: 99.9% SLA, and secured logging for 365 days. We are also interested in a sample committed-capacity quote for reserved GPU pools (Dedicated) vs hosted.

Can you send a v1.1 with a short change log that addresses the questions above and shows how a 3-year, 30M/month commitment would be priced? Also want a one-page summary for procurement to present to finance.

Best,
Elaine
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Elaine Park <elaine@brightapps.com>, BrightApps Procurement <procurement@brightapps.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-02T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API rate card and baseline pricing

Elaine — thanks, good questions. I've attached redwood_ratecard_hosted_v1.1.pdf which includes:
- A change log (v1.0 -> v1.1) describing multi-year step-downs, spike protection language, and model-eval credit guidance.
- A sample 3-year committed scenario for 30M tokens/month (annualized price, monthly invoice credit flow shown).
- Dedicated vs Hosted cost comparison page with example SLA delta and dedicated GPU uplift.

Short answers (TL;DR):
- Multi-year: we offer step-down pricing in years 2 and 3 (typically 5% year-2, 3% year-3 on top of tiered discounts) as shown in the sample.
- Spike protection: we negotiate a capped overage rate for predictable billing; the cap is a % overspend threshold (we can specify a 20% cap for enterprise deals) and reconciled monthly.
- Model-eval credits: we can provide a one-time evaluation credit applied to your first invoice (amount depends on pilot size; Marcus will propose an example credit for the 3-month pilot).

Next steps: Marcus will prepare the formal illustrative quote and a 1-page procurement summary (should be in your inbox within 24 hours). I'll include the attachments and hubspot deal link for your legal and finance teams.

Attachments: redwood_ratecard_hosted_v1.1.pdf

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
